featured.title: A collaborative multi-agent framework for real-time multimodal depression monitoring
points: Wearable sensors: EEG, head and limb movement, and voice, processed by 4 specialized agents and a fusion orchestrator.
Two-level stacking model evaluated on a cohort of 30 participants.
Runs on low-cost embedded hardware, under 50 ms per 3-second window.
Live clinical dashboard.
featured.disclaimer: A monitoring system, not a diagnostic tool.
featured.coverAlt: Screenshot of the clinical dashboard: live monitoring of EEG, head, limb and voice modalities, with arm and leg sensor signals
